# Parleo

> Parleo is the incentive intelligence layer for agentic commerce: a structured API and directory that lets AI agents access merchant loyalty, rewards, and true-cost data in a single sub-50ms call.

Parleo gives AI shopping agents a pre-computed view of loyalty programs, card-linked offers, points multipliers, and true cost — so the agent can rank products by real value, not headline price. Built for beauty, fashion, luxury, and consumer electronics brands.
